SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices and delivers them ready to use across Penukonda. We build each unit to order at our own ISO-certified factory and dispatch it fitted — walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done — to the Kia auto-vendor belt at Erramanchi, the NH44 corridor and auto-ancillary plots around Penukonda and the wider Anantapur district. You deal with the maker, not a reseller or a marketplace listing. For models, sizes and finishes, see our full Container Office Manufacturer for Penukonda Auto Vendors range, then send your requirement for a quote.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. Because it arrives finished, your team can move in the day it lands — no site masonry, no wet work and no long build wait. In an auto-manufacturing belt like Penukonda, that lets a Kia vendor or an ancillary plant add an admin office, a QC room or a site cabin without holding up the line.

Who buys a container office in Penukonda

Penukonda has grown around the Kia plant at Erramanchi and its base of auto-component and ancillary vendors. Most of our enquiries here come from:

  • Auto-component and Tier-1/Tier-2 vendor plants needing an admin, QC or supervisor office on site
  • Ancillary and APIIC-plot units needing a clean, insulated cabin during setup or expansion
  • EPC and civil contractors needing a temporary site office for a plant project
  • Units needing a gate and security office at the plot entrance

Every unit we supply is an administrative or site cabin — a clean, insulated workspace. We do not market these as process, paint-shop or hazardous-area structures.

Where we deliver in and around Penukonda

We supply container offices across the main industrial pockets of the Penukonda belt:

  • Kia plant belt at Erramanchi, Penukonda mandal — 515110
  • Penukonda town and the NH44 auto-vendor corridor — 515110
  • Auto-ancillary and APIIC plots around Penukonda — 515110
  • Wider Anantapur district and Hindupur-side project sites — served on enquiry

This belt runs on auto components, engineering and vendor support — buyers who often need a clean office added quickly beside a working line. Share your exact plot and gate access, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Which container office suits your Penukonda site

Different jobs call for different cabins. As a guide:

  • A gate or single-desk security point — a 10 ft cabin
  • An admin, QC or supervisor office — a 20 ft cabin, the most common choice
  • A larger office with a meeting or record area — a 40 ft cabin, which can be partitioned
  • A full vendor team on an auto-plant project — a container site office for auto-plant vendor teams

Container office sizes

SizeTypical useNotes
10 ftGate office or single supervisor cabinCompact, single door
20 ftAdmin, QC or supervisor officeMost common for vendor units
40 ftLarge office with meeting or record areaCan be partitioned

Internal usable area and layout are confirmed at quotation, since we build to order rather than from stock.

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Penukonda is built to the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with a GI sheet roof
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat inside the cabin through the Rayalaseema summer
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, and steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness, wiring load and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price you get is honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your unit works. Common additions for Penukonda sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, a document-storage area, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Bangalore factory

Penukonda is served from our Bangalore factory on South-zone dispatch. The road route runs up NH44 via Devanahalli, Chikkaballapur and Bagepalli into Penukonda — roughly 150–180 km depending on your plot, one of our shorter South runs. Transit is typically within our standard 3–5 day window after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable; the exact freight and any crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the wider corridor See our our Bangalore-built container offices, our Tirupati container office page, and container offices we take to Hyderabad sites.

Documentation for vendor onboarding

Auto vendors around the Kia belt supply into large OEMs and need clean paperwork. As a registered Private Limited manufacturer, we issue a proper GST invoice (GSTIN 29ABBCS7101B1ZR) and an e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration. This keeps procurement and audit straightforward.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Penukonda

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the delivery distance to Penukonda. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote — no guesswork, no hidden add-ons.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Penukonda?

There is no single fixed price. The cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the delivery distance to your Penukonda site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote the same way for every buyer.

Do you deliver to the Kia plant belt and Erramanchi side?

Yes. We dispatch from our Bangalore factory up NH44 via Bagepalli to the Kia belt at Erramanchi, Penukonda town and the auto-ancillary plots around Penukonda (515110) — about 150–180 km. We confirm the schedule and offloading with your quote.

Which size suits an auto-component plant admin or QC office?

A 20 ft cabin covers most admin, QC and supervisor needs, a 10 ft cabin suits a gate or single-desk point, and a 40 ft cabin suits a larger office with a meeting area. Layouts are customised and confirmed at quotation.

Do you provide a GST invoice and certificate numbers for vendor onboarding?

Yes. We are a GST-registered Private Limited manufacturer and issue a GST invoice and e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration.

Call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440 to discuss your container office in Penukonda, or send an enquiry with your size and site details for a quote.
